arguments.message: If you re‑import a file that contains rows that already imported, the system will match them by email (for contacts) or by the unique identifier you supplied. It will update the existing record instead of creating a duplicate. This works as long as the field you’re using for matching hasn’t changed. If you corrected the email or identifier itself, the importer can’t recognise the row as the same one, so the safest approach is to delete the already‑imported rows from the corrected file before re‑running it.
